_about: Katana's A3 landscape plot frame: the sheet border, the title-block strip and its cells, the field slots and the text rules, measured from the owner's cross-section app so that a Katana sheet plots exactly like it. Coordinates are millimetres on the paper with the origin at the bottom-left and Y up (the *_tbf values); anchor_tbf already includes each text's offset and raise. Organisation branding has been removed: the logo cell, the organisation cell and the notes cell are empty slots the user fills (their own logo image, organisation name and notes). See docs/plotting.md.

coordinates.tbf_origin: bottom-left of the sheet, Y up
coordinates.convert: y_svg = 297 - y_tbf, applied per coordinate rather than by a mirror transform, so text is not mirrored (sheet.js:4-7)
coordinates.text_anchor: a text is drawn at (x + offset, y + raise); six texts carry a non-zero offset/raise (#25, #127, #160, #171, #174, #175) and anchor_tbf already includes it (sheet.js:197-198)
coordinates.angles: degrees counter-clockwise in tbf; the SVG uses rotate(-angle) (sheet.js:233)

sheet.width_height_hardcoded: tbf.js:228-229 (only the margins are read from the .tbf)

sheet_edge_tbf.note: construction layer, acad 030 (#ff8000), 0.18 mm. sheet.js draws it (an orange hairline at the paper edge in the render). Treat it as a guide that does not plot. Entity 41 is a second construction rectangle 420.5 wide.

draw_order: panels in array order, which is the z-order (sheet.js:619-626)
interactive only: chrome layer with selection handles and a dashed blue plot-frame guide (main.js:228-233)

palette_rule: colors.js resolve(): CAD "white" and acad 7 plot black; acad N follows the AutoCAD colour index (hue=(N-10)/10*15 degrees, shade table); pens 0/7/18 are black (colors.js:54-122)

text_rules.font: textstyle "82Arial" is pen prefix "82" plus face Arial, rendered as "Arial, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif" (sheet.js:185-190). Only the disclaimer uses "Arial Narrow".
text_rules.size: worldsize is the CAP height in mm; SVG font-size = worldsize / 0.716, the Arial cap-height ratio (sheet.js:181-196)
text_rules.x_factor: horizontal stretch about the anchor via scale(xf,1) (sheet.js:234-237); nearly every label uses 0.82 (condensed)
text_rules.justify: "vertical-horizontal", e.g. bottom-left or middle-centre; horizontal maps to text-anchor start/middle/end, vertical to baseline alphabetic/central/hanging (sheet.js:160-179)
text_rules.multiline: anchored on the FIRST line and grows downward whatever the justification; line pitch is 1.5 x cap height (sheet.js:205-206, 243-247, 276-281)
text_rules.centred_fields: scale (user_text_17), drawing_number and total sheets (user_text_1) are re-centred in the ruled cell found from the vertical rules (sheet.js:211-223, main.js:472-475)
text_rules.squeeze: a left-anchored single-line field wider than the room to the next vertical rule gets textLength=room and lengthAdjust=spacingAndGlyphs (sheet.js:262-272)
text_rules.lift_off_rule: a baseline closer than 0.24 em above a horizontal rule is lifted clear, capped by the headroom under the rule above (sheet.js:132-156, 228-230)
text_rules.leading_space: several field texts start with a space, e.g. " $drawing_number" (a template artefact the app keeps)

cells.purpose: the whole drawing; panels are placed in the viewport inset (23,35)-(410,287)
label SCALE (#109) and value user_text_17, cap 3, centred in the cell (#127). The value is DERIVED from the plotted scale and read-only (main.js:446-497)
static "HEIGHT DATUM: A.H.D." (#107); should become a field
FILE NAME: with user_text_19 on a dashed underline at y 14.768; MODEL NAME: with user_text_7 on a dashed underline at y 10.022
LOGO slot: the user's own logo image, fitted with its aspect kept and about 1 mm padding; empty by default

Four rows, UTILITIES/SURVEYED/COMPILED/REVIEWED. Name fields user_text_3..6 (cap 1.5) sit on dashed lines x 176.488-201.661 at y 19.977/16.477/12.977/9.477; DATE: and $time sit on dashed lines x 208.62-219.273 at the same y
NOTES slot: the user's own multi-line notes or disclaimer (narrow text, cap 0.85, line pitch 1.275, first line anchored at (220.918, 32.961)); empty by default
"SURVEY UNIT MANAGER:" with user_text_2 (cap 2) on a dashed line 242.167-277.840 at 10.501; DATE: and $time on a dashed line 284.126-295.973 at 10.513
ORGANISATION slot: the user's organisation or client name (cap 3.738), blank by default
five-line middle-centre block (#177): LGA / Address / Address Details / Purpose / Drawing Set Number, cap 2.5, first line anchored at (350.275, 26.447)
"No. of" / "SHEETS" with user_text_1, cap 3, centred. Total sheets; crosssect does NOT derive it from the sheet count
"SHEET No." with $drawing_number, cap 3, centred. This sheet's number, set automatically on Add/Duplicate sheet (main.js:2452, 2470)
rotated 90 degrees: "Survey Plan Filename:" (#36) and user_text_19 (#170) up the left margin
"A3 Border version: 2.0    $time", cap 1 (#40), below the title block

field_semantics.user_text_1: Total Sheet Number, shown in the No. of SHEETS cell; default "1" (main.js:31); never recomputed from the sheet count
field_semantics.drawing_number: SHEET No. cell; default "1"; set to index+1 on Add/Duplicate sheet
field_semantics.plot_date: every $time (6 DATE cells and the stamp) shows ONE value: the override, or today as dd/mm/yy (tbf.js:361-381)
field_semantics.user_text_17: SCALE, derived as "H 1:{scale}  V 1:{scale/vExag}" and read-only (main.js:484-497, 1007)
field_semantics.user_text_19: pdf_filename: printed twice (rotated in the left margin and in the FILE NAME cell) and used as the export base name (main.js:3503-3507)
field_semantics.others: free text, typed in the sidebar field list or by clicking the text on the sheet (main.js:966-1060); "Fill from JSON" maps project metadata onto the fields (main.js:1062-1085)

regional_conventions: "HEIGHT DATUM: A.H.D." (#107, Australian Height Datum), hard-coded
"CO-ORD SYSTEM: MGA.. ZONE .." (#108, Map Grid of Australia)
PUBLIC UTILITY LEGEND (AS 5488 / Before You Dig colours; the symbols are redrawn in symbols.js)
symbols_glyphs: symbols.js:39-117: 15 procedural glyphs in a -1..1 local box, scaled by size, stroke 0.18/size so every symbol plots at 0.18 mm; an unknown style draws an open 0.8 square
